escena: SCENE (colour review, post studio in Bogota, evening): a SPLIT-DIOPTER shot — two planes at very different distances are BOTH perfectly sharp at the same time, which no normal lens can do. Verify it by these landmarks: in the near left of the frame, a printed proof held up close to the lens is razor sharp down to its paper grain; far behind it on the right, he stands several metres away and is ALSO razor sharp, down to his glasses; and between the two there is a soft vertical seam where the two fields of focus meet. A single hard desk lamp rakes across the proof from the left and a cool monitor glow edges him from behind. He lowers his hand at the instant he agrees with what is on the proof. He wears a faded olive linen shirt; no navy or blue clothing. He looks at the proof, never at the camera. Everything is completely unbranded, no readable text anywhere.

lecho.objeto: the near edge of the console in shadow at the bottom of the frame
lecho.tono: DARK near black in shadow, matte
